working_title: Observation-Anchored Evidence Recovery for Irregular-Time 3D Single-Object Tracking
central_claim: Physical-time-guided extension evidence may apply only a calibrated bounded correction; otherwise the tracker exactly preserves the current observation.

conditional_claims.physical_time: Requires true > fixed and shuffled under matched scratch and held-out cadence.
conditional_claims.memory: Requires real > empty and time_misaligned with stable paired confidence intervals.

claim_guardrails: No gain, stability, SOTA, physical-time, or memory claim before the registered experiments pass.
Agreement is an input feature, not reliability itself.
Fixed Gaussian quantiles are not calibrated two-dimensional coverage.
Predicted-box membership is not ground-truth foreground.
Calibration is empirical finite-sample control, not a distribution-free guarantee.
blockers: The local machine has no discovered nuScenes data root and lacks the complete Lightning/nuScenes Python environment.
Server-side real-batch, resume-parity, and visualization checks were explicitly waived for this slimming pass; dormant compatibility branches therefore remain physically present.
The registered v24 mini and full-nuScenes experiments have not run.
